summaries.summary: The page details atypical presentations of appendicitis, listing locations of the appendix and associated signs/symptoms. It includes a diagram showing anatomical positions of the appendix (e.g., anterior, posterior, pelvic). The symptom 'Diarrhoea, crampy pain' is linked to the 'Retro/paraleal' location of the appendix.
key_facts: Diarrhoea and crampy pain are signs/symptoms associated with the retro/paraleal location of the appendix.
The diagram illustrates anatomical positions of the appendix including anterior, posterior, pelvic, and other regions.
